patch.objective: Interpret the fetal heart rate baseline -- 110 to 160 bpm with moderate variability -- and respond to an abnormal tracing by repositioning or stopping oxytocin

sources.note: Relayed from the ADN-RN course's earlier cases (read 2026-11-11, primary PDF), not re-read for this band: the pre-licensure RN course is built toward this test plan.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.

Relayed from the NCLEX-RN case oxytocin-tachysystole-late-decels, not re-read for this band; its note: Relayed from the REQ-233 NCLEX-RN cases (read 2026-11-11, primary PDF), not re-read: Reduction of Risk Potential includes testing within the nurse's scope such as fetal monitoring; Pharmacological Therapies includes titrating a dose against ordered parameters.

sources.cite: Giles A, Prusinski R, Wallace L. Maternal Newborn Nursing (OpenStax, 2024-06-26), 16.4 Nursing Interventions Based on Fetal Heart Rate and Uterine Contraction Patterns
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-RN case oxytocin-tachysystole-late-decels, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch with quotes: 'an FHR baseline between 110 and 160 bpm with moderate variability' is one of the most reliable signs of adequate fetal oxygenation; late decelerations go with uteroplacental insufficiency, and Table 16.5 lists 'Discontinue oxytocin', 'Consider terbutaline if tachysystole', 'Change position to left lateral', 'Correct hypotension with fluid bolus' and 'Notify the HCP'; with tachysystole 'the nurse will discontinue oxytocin, if in use, and administer a tocolytic medication such as terbutaline'; Category II tracings get intrauterine resuscitation, and those that do not respond become Category III.

sources.cite: National Certification Corporation. Monograph 2: NICHD terminology and definitions (2016), as hosted by the Oklahoma Perinatal Quality Improvement Collaborative
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-RN case oxytocin-tachysystole-late-decels, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch with quotes: baseline is the approximate mean FHR rounded to 5 bpm over 10 minutes, bradycardia below 110 and tachycardia above 160; moderate variability 'Amplitude range 6-25 bpm'; a late deceleration's nadir occurs after the peak of the contraction; tachysystole is 'more than 5 contractions in a 10 minute segment averaged over a 30 minute period'.
